item.title: NOPD 'Drones for First Responders' pilot program is one step closer to approval
item.description: The new "Drones for First Responders" pilot program is one step closer to reality after the French Quarter Management District Security Committee approved spending $250,000 on a new drone docking station and drone.

item.title: No injuries despite storm downing dozens of trees in Tangipahoa Parish
item.description: In the aftermath of a severe storm emergency officials believe Tangipahoa Parish dodged a bullet. The parish was not completely spared though. Crews spent the day clearing downed trees off of powerlines and roads.
